summary: Equinix Canada Financing Ltd, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of Equinix Inc, issued C$1.25 billion aggregate principal of senior notes via an underwriting agreement dated April 30, 2026, comprising C$650 million 3.950% notes due 2030 and C$600 million 4.750% notes due 2035, fully guaranteed by Equinix. The notes were issued under a base indenture and supplemental indentures with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee, offered under an effective shelf registration statement. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No special-situation terms, event, or strategic action is implied.
